state.objective: Determine why browser blocks POST requests from app.domain.com to api.domain.com.

context.content: 2026-10-03T12:00:00Z OPTIONS /v1/checkout HTTP/1.1 response: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * but Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; browser rejects credentials with wildcard origin

submitted_answer.answer: The credentialed cross-origin POST is blocked because CORS returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Configure an explicit trusted origin (https://app.domain.com), disable the wildcard, and include it in Access-Control-Allow-Headers as needed.
